lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-uniform 2D grid pattern, situated posterior to the gill slits and ventral to the primary lateral ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from light (superior) to shadow (inferior).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, dark silhouettes (remoras) located ventral to the main body and posterior to the left pectoral fin.
